title: Figure Critique
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact (advisory). Output of figure-vlm-critic. Records per-figure findings derived deterministically from figure_spec_bundle structure checks (truncated axis, dual-axis confusion, missing error bars, etc.) merged with any viz_audit_report signals. Advisory only — no BLOCK verdict. Real PNG/VLM critique is an out-of-band step until a render/GPU server exists.

findings.description: Per-figure findings. Empty array means no findings were raised.

figure_id.description: The figure_id from the figure_spec_bundle this finding pertains to.

severity.description: Advisory severity. Never triggers a BLOCK gate.

evidence_ref.description: Non-empty list of evidence pointers — anti-slop guard.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the finding. Optional.
